reviews.title: The worst
reviews.text: I started using this app when there were some free features and I liked it enough to upgrade to pro because I liked the AI designs.  it wasn’t good for actual design, but it was good for inspiration.  I just downloaded an update and the interface has changed significantly. It seems like it could offer you some improvements. You actually get to choose a color scheme, and there are more styles than there used to be to choose from. However, I chose vintage style for my kitchen with golden ocher color scheme, and it literally painted everything white and did no redesigning whatsoever.  Oh and to rub salt in the wound, they have bow added credits which you use anytime you use the app so even though you are paying you are now limited and if you try to edit the “design” the AI came up with, it costs note credits.  I can understand wanting to be paid for people to use your product, but this has turned into a complete scam.

reviews.title: Crumby AI
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for about two weeks. I’ve tried multiple times to upload my floorplans through the AI program. Each time the dimensions have been completely off and when I try to correct it throws the entire house off. I’ve never seen an AI program that is so off when the numbers are very clearly seen on the blueprint, as well as the floorplans picture, which clearly have the dimensions. This would be a phenomenal app if the AI program worked and copied the floorplans with the correct dimensions.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: I’m glad I only paid for the weekly sub. I uploaded my apartment’s floor plan as provided by my apartment’s management. The sizes and rooms are clearly labeled, and somehow the AI thinks my living room is 40 ft wide. Manually drawing the floor plan is like pulling teeth. Unironically, The Sims 4 is free. If you’re just trying to experiment with layouts, that might be the better move. IKEA also offers a service where you can draw a room and experiment with placing IKEA furniture. This app crutches a lot on IKEA, and the IKEA service is much easier to use, so why use this app?

I can only see the layout of the place which makes no sense if I can’t see what it would look like with furniture! It would be so nice to have some of those features back. Never using this all again

reviews.title: Terrible service and payment
reviews.text: This app is not that easy to navigate. Even if it uses AI, there are many options that are egregiously overpriced for its service. Navigating the app is a bit confusing. Searching for basic art and concepts to decorate. It’s not that easy. Sometimes art floats around in the center of the room or off the walls a bit. Especially if you plan on hanging it above a shelf or piece of furniture. You only get to choose from items that are available in actual stores and there is no basic in stock furniture items to choose from for concept ideas. Also, when I purchased the subscription, I had plenty of funds for the app to process my purchase. Instead, when I wasn’t happy with the app, I canceled at the end of the first month. Expecting the subscription to be pulled prior. Instead, they decided to charge my account the day I canceled, which was way after I had made my purchase. It didn’t make sense because it wasn’t like I was accumulating usage, and they should’ve just charged me from the beginning when I agreed to the monthly subscription and paid for it using Apple Cash. This locked my Apple account from downloading any apps because I didn’t have enough funds to process the payment later. I didn’t mind paying for the subscription to test out the app, but because I was charged so late, I demanded a refund. I wouldn’t recommend this app. For Interior Decorator online, I would suggest using something online on a tablet or desktop. This isn’t user-friendly on the phone as an app.

reviews.title: Does not work as advertised, Misrepresention
reviews.text:
I downloaded and tried this app on good faith, with the reviews being high. 

I signed up for a subscription as to me, the value it could provide would far exceed the sub $$… however one of the key functions is being able to upload your own floor plan… I tried 3 different uploads, first one was so incorrect, it added rooms over top of each other and cut rooms completely off. So I tried a more basic floor plan…I’m not sure if this was worse but it added rooms and bathrooms in places that wasn’t even on the floor plan… there was more wrong than right, faster to start over than try to correct the inconsistencies. I tried a 3rd time and it wasn’t any better… 

I tried to cancel and it’s been a nightmare since.. I’m not going to tell anyone what to do, but just beware, and I’ve yet to receive a full refund. It’s not the money at this point, it’s the principle that a company/app developer can charge for capabilities and not deliver and keep part of your money… I used this for less than 30 min and it did nothing it advertised and yet they get to keep some of my money… there is a word for that…it isn’t good business for sure…

reviews.text:
I’ve been trying to recreate same kitchen layout for 40 mins straight and I failed because of the same bug that appears every few minutes. 
After arranging kitchen elements, when selecting the next item the previous elements suddenly disappear with an element reappearing that you tried long ago, for no clear reason. The undo function doesn’t help: it jumps back to a very old state with the element that reappeared and wipes out everything done after that. Forward button doesn’t work in that case either. This happens every few minutes. And I cannot even save the progress, it’s done automatically somehow.
For a paid app this is unacceptable. Will cancel my subscription.

reviews.title: Paid version is still hard to use — they want you to upgrade TWICE
reviews.text:
I used this app 4 years ago for a room re-design and I loved it! I paid for a monthly fee for their upgraded version and it was so easy to use and simple. I expected the same type of app but better since it’s been a few years, and instead it was worse. It is so complicated to use from a mobile device. I upgraded to a 6 month plan for $35 (only because it was the best deal) and I found out half of the features I wanted were still locked behind a second paywall that would cost me $100 for 6 months. I used it for maybe 20 minutes before deciding I had to cancel and there’s no way to get any sort of refund, so I’m emailing them and hoping for the best. 
I’m sure some people have found success, but honestly the cost is just too high for what you actually get. 

Also, check your profile settings. They had a toggle that said the app could access your location that I didn’t know about… not sure about everyone else but I don’t want an AI house planning app to be able to see my location.
